| # CANopen features description {#canopen-features-description-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                        |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Refer to [Features Supported](storage-of-confidential-inform.html){.topiclink} by the CANopen library.

The implementation of major features is explained in the below sections

 

- [NMT in CANopen lib](nmt-in-canopen-lib.html){.topiclink}

- [SDO in CANopen lib](sdo-in-canopen-lib.html){.topiclink}

- [PDO in CANopen lib](pdo-in-canopen-lib.html){.topiclink}

- [LSS in CANopen lib](lss-in-canopen-lib.html){.topiclink}

 

The implementation of features like heartbeat, emergency, and sync protocol are described by their respective API and code examples.

Safety features like SRDO and GFC are described in [CANopen safety-SRDO and GFC](canopen-safety---srdo-and-gfc.html){.topiclink}

A special implementation that allows for an easy-to-use configuration of the CANopen library, is described in the section  Easy-to-use APIs
